description: Mash 2.3 'mash sketch -o x.msh': the sketch file of the inputs, byte for byte as the program writes it (120 random runs equal, and 300 more with the alphabet options -a -z -Z: genomes and read sets, k 4 - 32, sketch sizes 1 - 3000, seeds, -n, -i, -r -m -c -g with all the files of a read set in ONE sketch, -I / -C, -l). The file is a Cap'n Proto message of MinHash.capnp built as capnp::MallocMessageBuilder builds it (segments of 1024, 1024, 2048, ... words, far pointers with landing pads); it is returned as base64 and, prefixed with 'msh:', it is accepted by mash_dist / mash_triangle / mash_screen / mash_info / mash_paste as an input. One sketch per file (its name is the file name, its comment the first record's name and comment) or, with individual, one per sequence. -l (a list of file names) is the caller's list of inputs.

sequences.description: The input files as FASTA texts (records start with '>': the first word of the header is the sequence id, the rest the comment).

names.description: Names of the inputs as the program stores them (the file names; default input1, ...).

k.description: k-mer size (-k, 1 - 32; default 21, or 9 with protein).

seed.description: Hash seed (-S, 0 - 4294967295, default 42; 42 is stored in referenceListOld, another seed in referenceList).

individual.description: -i: sketch individual sequences instead of whole files.

reads.description: -r: the inputs are read sets (noise filter -m, target coverage -c, genome size -g); the hash counts are stored.

minCopies.description: -m: minimum copies of each k-mer required to pass the noise filter of a read set (default 1; only with reads).

targetCoverage.description: -c: target coverage of a read set (default 0 = read everything; only with reads).

genomeSize.description: -g: genome size used as the sketch length of a read set (default 0 = estimated; only with reads).

id.description: -I: the id (name) of the first sketch.

comment.description: -C: the comment of the first sketch.

bloomFilter.description: -b: a Bloom filter of this size (raw bytes or with K/M/G/T, e.g. 500M) filters out the k-mers seen once, instead of the exact filter -m (cannot be combined with minCopies > 1; implies reads; copies cannot be counted beyond 2; some unique k-mers pass erroneously; the filter has one hash function over bytes x 8 bits as the program builds it).

protein.description: -a: the amino-acid alphabet (A-Z except BJOUXZ; implies -n and, without k, -k 9): k-mers of the 20 letters, 64-bit hashes when 20^k > 2^32, p-values over the k-mer space 20^k.

alphabet.description: -z: the alphabet the hashes are based on (case ignored unless preserveCase; k-mers with other characters are ignored; implies -n; ASCII only: the program has no defined result for a byte of 0x80 or more). protein takes precedence.

preserveCase.description: -Z: preserve the case of the letters in the k-mers and the alphabet (a letter whose case is not in the alphabet is skipped).

errors.message: Invalid arguments (the program's message for incompatible options or a sketch file that is not a .msh).
